name: print-shop-canvas-skill
tagline_zh: 做海报、名片、贴纸总被印厂打回来：分辨率不够、忘了出血、裁切线压到字。它用 PIL 按物理毫米算版面。
tagline_en: Tired of print shops rejecting your files over DPI, missing bleed, or trim marks cutting text? This renders.
desc_en: Generator grafis dinamis dan layout percetakan presisi fisik via Python PIL/Pillow: rendering 300 DPI, margin bleed mesin potong, dan ekspor PDF siap cetak workshop.
why_zh: 版面按毫米和 DPI 反推像素，不是先画图再放大。出血、安全区、裁切线在生成时就写进坐标。
why_en: Pixels are derived from millimeters and DPI, not scaled up afterward. Bleed, safe area, and crop marks are baked into.
limit_zh: 只出静态位图排版和 PDF，不做矢量路径、不嵌字体子集、不转 CMYK——印厂要专色或矢量源文件时它给不了。
limit_en: Raster layouts and PDF only: no vector paths, no font subsetting, no CMYK conversion. Needs Pillow installed and a font path you supply yourself.
title_en: Python print-layout generator that outputs press-ready 300.
